header.name: Mayukh Chakraborty
header.title: Manager, Product Design
tagline: UX Strategist. Human-AI Orchestrator. Global Design Manager.
summary: IMPACT (250K businesses across Progress and HashiCorp)

bullets: **Agentic AI & Workflow Innovation:** Spearheaded the end-to-end design of an automated Terraform upgrade experience. Leveraged agentic AI flows to guide DevOps engineers through high-risk migrations across core, modules, and providers. This initiative resulted in 80% of HCP Terraform workspaces migrating to the latest version, increasing Resources Under Management (RUM) and driving business revenue. Prototyped using **Claude code and Helios Design System MCP server**. Also played an important role in developing the design system MCP server.

**North Star Visioning & Technical Prototyping:** Defined the North Star interaction model for a Terraform infrastructure visualization VS Code extension. Empowered developers to validate complex cloud architectures directly within their IDE. Accelerated the design-to-development cycle by using Claude and AI-assisted coding to build high-fidelity, functional prototypes.

**Enterprise-Grade User Research:** Directed foundational research with technical stakeholders at Tier-1 financial institutions (e.g., JPMC, DBS Bank). Translated complex friction points in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows into a streamlined, low-risk upgrade roadmap for large-scale enterprise environments.
Redesigned HashiCorp Consul UI to align with the **HashiCorp Helios design system** and achieve **WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance**, improving consistency, usability across the product.

**Strategically led and scaled a high-performing, geographically distributed UX organization** (Design, Research, Content Strategy), growing the team from 2 to 7 designers across the US, Bulgaria and India and collaborating with Senior Executive stakeholders (VP/Sr. Director/Fellows) to align initiatives with business, technical, and Developer Experience (DevEx) objectives across platforms serving over 100,000 global businesses.

**Spearheaded a comprehensive UX strategy** applied to the end-to-end design of the **OpenEdge Command Center (OECC)**. By enabling seamless management of **IT Security and Operations** across **hybrid cloud environments**, this initiative drove an **80% increase in adoption** of the latest OpenEdge version and cloud migration.

**Launched the AI-Enabled Memory Profiler tool** as a hands-on design manager, a critical DevEx solution that **reduced inbound support calls and forum inquiries by 50%** by enabling users to efficiently identify and resolve complex memory issues.
Drove a **25% increase in OpenEdge platform CSAT**, the platform that OECC and the Memory Profiler are part of.

**Established a WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant design system**, including its visual design, and UX best practices, accelerating **product delivery timelines by 30%** through the reduction of design debt and implementation of accessible Dark, Light, and Classic themes across core product suites.

**Drove data-informed design decisions** by directing **50+ customer interviews across 25 customers**, usability testing, and integrating analytics tools (Pendo/CUJ metrics); interviewed customers from **financial institutions (DSK Bank, AmBank Group, Associated Bank)** and leveraged data analysis to identify and redesign a critical user-flow bottleneck in the ARC Configuration Manager, improving key conversion rates.

**Hosted engaging webinars** via the Customer Validation Portal and User Group (PUG) conferences, establishing continuous feedback loops that directly fuelled product roadmap improvements and design validation.
experience.subtitle: Joined May 2018 as Senior UX Designer; Principal UX Designer from July 2020 (7 years at Progress)
(IIT Kanpur incubated startup funded by Hyderabad Angels)
bullets: Worked directly with the founder to set up the product design function single-handedly and build the team, then led six designers and front-end developers as Head of Design, acting as the lead architect for the end-to-end UX/UI design of the Healer Management System (HMS).

Spearheaded digital growth: built the corporate website from scratch, designed marketing material (posters, brochures, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube ads), optimized SEO/SEM with external agencies, and designed A/B tested landing pages that resulted in a 75% increase in lead conversion.

experience.subtitle: (IIT Kanpur incubated startup funded by SIDBI)
bullets: As co-founder, recruited the designers, engineers and interns and led the end-to-end product design and gamification strategy for a first-of-its-kind local social networking app from ideation to launch. Designed marketing material: posters, brochures, Facebook, Instagram and YouTube ads.
Designed optimized user flows and onboarding journeys that drove **31,000+ users and 1.6M+ messages in 9 weeks**, then 50,000+ installs and 5,000+ DAUs in about six months, at a low CAC of ~₹15.
Lead an 11-person team of software engineers from onsite (Ohio, US) in the full automation testing of the mission-critical Cardinal Health OrderExpress B2B e-commerce platform.
Designed and deployed an automatic test-script generation tool used by client Cardinal Health, cutting manual work by 90%.
Recognized for innovation by receiving the esteemed Hercules Award.
